                  <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4633"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3693">sdud pa tshigs su bcad
                     pa</rs>'i bshad sbyar</rs>
                  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6961">slob dpon ye shes
                     zhabs</rs> kyi dgongs pa la 'khrul pa spang pa'i phyir | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5878">shag kya'i rge slong ye shes rgyal
                     mtshan</rs> gyis sbyar ba'o || rdzogs so|| ×|| ×|| <lb n="40b3"/>
                  <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5656">rgyan dkar × phug<anchor xml:id="a1"/></rs> du bris so || × ||</seg>

               <milestone unit="section" n=" [Colophon Part 2 "/>
               <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex22032024-10-1509-181" status="unreviewed"> || shes rab
                  pha rol tu phyin pa'i | don la dmyigs shing 'khrul pa'i skyon rnams sel cing sku ×
                  'khrungs pa'i | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">dam
                     pa shes rab 'bar</rs> zhes grags | chu snod cig nas cig byo bzhin | don dang
                  tshig rnams rdzogs par yang| 'gro la phan phyir don rnams sgrogs <lb n="40b4"/>
                  gsregs? don<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5878"> ye shes
                     rgyal</rs> zhes grags | skye* shis 'jigs nas chos rgyad bor || don tsam snang
                  yang bye brag rjed [=brjed?]| dran pa bso phyir <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4335">chos 'khor bsam yas</rs> dag du
                  bris | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6962">dge' bshes
                     zhug ston</rs> zhes byar grags || 'gro ba 'dul kyin bzhan don mdzad | *thos
                  mang sems <note type="gloss">dang</note> sims? kyi * me long lta || <lb n="40b5"/>
                  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shes rab thog po</rs> zhes su
                  grags || || || ||ItI|| ||</seg></seg></TEI>
